stories.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
stories.simple_summary: A Yale business professor says Nvidia, the chip company, may actually be harmful to America's strength because it has sold advanced chips to countries that compete against us. The founder's return to run the company might create legal problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about big business and politics. Unless you own stock in Nvidia or work in the semiconductor industry, this doesn't affect your day-to-day life or small business.

stories.title: Jensen Huang still thinks a succession plan creates unnecessary hierarchy
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's founder Jensen Huang doesn't like the idea of training someone else to take over his job. This is unusual since the company just went through a rough patch when he stepped away.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly interesting to investors and company watchers. It doesn't impact how you use AI or run a small business.

stories.title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
stories.simple_summary: Jensen Huang apologized to his employees after returning to lead Nvidia and said he is seeing a therapist. He thanked the White House for supporting his return.
stories.why_it_matters: This is company news that mainly interests investors and Nvidia employees. It won't change how AI works for you.

stories.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
stories.simple_summary: AI helpers that people are starting to use can't reliably do everyday tasks like shopping or booking appointments without making mistakes. Even the best AI still struggles with real-world problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to you because it means AI assistants aren't ready to handle important tasks alone yet. Don't expect them to fully replace humans for critical decisions.

stories.title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
stories.simple_summary: Walmart now lets customers browse and buy Black Friday deals using Meta's AI helper called Muse instead of visiting the website or store themselves.
stories.why_it_matters: If you shop at Walmart during Black Friday, you have one more way to find deals. It's just another shopping option, so you can skip it if you prefer the regular way.

stories.title: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
stories.simple_summary: A new company called Maple built AI tools that use special encryption to keep your private information secret. Even Maple's own workers can't see your data.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters if you worry about privacy when using AI tools. This company is trying to solve that problem, though it's still a new startup and mostly for tech-savvy users right now.

stories.title: Jensen Huang reportedly tells Nvidia staff it’s ‘not true’ Trump got him rehired
stories.simple_summary: Jensen Huang told Nvidia employees that the White House and other leaders did not help him get rehired as CEO, though news reports suggest otherwise.
stories.why_it_matters: This is company politics and doesn't affect how you use technology or run a business.

stories.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, an AI company, sold shares to the public but the stock price has dropped below what it was worth during the sale. This may cause other AI companies to be worth less too.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors. If you don't own stock in AI companies, this financial news doesn't directly change your life.

stories.title: David Fincher is being dragged for suspected use of AI in his latest film
stories.simple_summary: Some people think the new movie by director David Fincher may have used AI to create some scenes because parts of the film look strange and unnatural.
stories.why_it_matters: This is entertainment news. It shows AI is showing up in movies, but it doesn't affect your daily life unless you're concerned about how movies are made.

stories.title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
stories.simple_summary: The UK's cyber security agency warns that hackers are now using AI tools to attack computers and networks by finding old security problems that companies haven't fixed yet.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to your small business if you have a computer network. Make sure you install security updates and change weak passwords, because AI makes it easier for criminals to find those mistakes.

stories.title: House duo wants oversight for self-improving AI models
stories.simple_summary: Two members of the House of Representatives want new rules to watch and control AI models that can improve themselves over time.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about possible future laws but nothing is decided yet. Keep an eye on AI news if new regulations would affect your business, but no action is needed from you right now.

stories.title: The global AI data center debate explained: How tech infrastructure is straining electricity and water resources
stories.simple_summary: AI data centers, which are huge computer facilities that power AI tools, use enormous amounts of electricity and water. This is straining the world's power and water supplies.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to everyone because it affects the environment and could eventually lead to higher energy and water costs in your area as AI demand grows.
